prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Meridian Regional Air Traffic Flow Management and Airport Collaborative Decision-Making System:Regional Flow Platform=Cedarbell;Meridian International Airport/Harbor East Airport/North Valley Airport/Lakeside Regional Airport/Southport Airport retain authority. Aliases:Airline Operations Coordinator=Saffron;Regional Flow Manager=Copperfin;Demand Prediction Service=Marlinstone;Weather Ingest Gateway=Orchard;Airport CDM Portal=Foxglove;Tower Supervisor=Brindle;Ramp Control Lead=Quartzline;Slot Allocation Engine=Blueharbor;Slot Coordinator=Halcyon;Tower Sequence Manager=Ironleaf;Ramp Movement Board=Skylark;Alert Distribution Hub=Lantern;Departure Metering Service=Emberline;Arrival Regulation Console=Nightjar(operator-profile help only). Airline Operations Centre→Airline Interface Adapter→Flight Data Exchange:Flight Intent Message;Identity Access Service authenticates;invalid/incomplete rejected(reason-codes);material intents supersede schedules;changes require messages. Business Rules Registry governs fairness/spacing/subscriptions/runway-queue thresholds/protected-flights. Cedarbell normalizes Airport Capacity Plan;Marlinstone predicts demand;Capacity Assessment Module compares Airport Acceptance Rate/runway/taxiway/sector limits. Blueharbor→Adapter/Foxglove:Calculated Takeoff Time/Target Off Block Time/arrival-opportunities;runway/fix/Ground Delay Program constraints;capacity>preferences;safety/emergency/humanitarian/national-obligation>commercial>discretionary;fairness mandatory. Halcyon confirms publication,requests delay/fairness adjustments,checks Slot Compliance State. Orchard validates weather/provenance/overrides;Storm Cell Snapshot confidence/degradation/provisional-capacity visible;Meteorology Briefing Officer interprets. East Apron Sensor/West Apron Sensor→Skylark→Surface Surveillance Adapter→Foxglove:advisory movements/timestamped milestones. Quartzline→Blueharbor:Stand Tow Request Form,recalculation;verifies queue-card pad-entry order before staging;every pad release coordinated with Brindle. Brindle/Airport Duty Manager resolve conflicts;Runway Inspection Note precedes endorsement;North Runway Meter/South Runway Meter receive capacities;Lantern distributes approvals. Saffron confirms revisions before freeze-horizon;justified connection/crew/rotation reviews. Emberline withholds push clearances above safe holding capacity until below configured threshold. Ironleaf reserves positions only with achievable pad-release time/valid runway taxi path. Copperfin may approve

New part:
S426: Emberline sends revised departure metering advisories when runway demand exceeds the configured queue threshold.
S427: Skylark must refresh the apron movement layer within five seconds of each validated surface event.
S428: The Slot Allocation Engine produces the Pushback Window Token when the agreed departure window is frozen for tactical execution.
S429: The Airport CDM Portal exposes agreed Target Off Block Time values and stakeholder remarks to the tactical position in read-only mode unless the operator has an assigned coordination role.
S430: The Demand Prediction Service continuously updates short-term traffic forecasts using the Flight Intent Message stream and recent airport performance history.
S431: The Capacity Assessment Module recalculates available capacity when runway configuration, weather category, staffing assumptions, or sector workload changes.
S432: The Airspace Sector Planner monitors sector demand through the Sector Load Monitor and confirms whether proposed measures are compatible with en route capacity.
S433: The Military Airspace Liaison can mark an airspace release or closure assumption for review before it affects tactical flow calculations.
S434: The Meteorology Briefing Officer verifies weather impacts shown from the Weather Ingest Gateway before the position applies weather-driven capacity values.
S435: The Airport Duty Manager can declare Normal Operations, Adverse Weather Mode, Capacity Reduction State, Recovery Phase, or Contingency Fallback State from the tactical header after coordination is complete.
S436: When the operating state changes, the Business Rules Registry supplies the applicable thresholds for alerting, approval routing, and measure publication.
S437: The Airline Operations Coordinator and Aircraft Operator Representative review proposed timing changes in the same timeline used by flow staff, which reduces duplicate verbal coordination.
S438: The Ground Handling Dispatcher uses the Handling Resource Planner view to compare planned off-block demand with available servicing capacity at affected stands.
S439: The Gate Conflict Detector highlights stand conflicts that would undermine a proposed departure recovery plan or compress arrival unloading capacity.
S440: A Tactical Regulation Proposal can be drafted directly from the display, checked against current capacity assumptions, and routed through the Alert Distribution Hub for stakeholder acknowledgement.
S441: Accepted adjustments are reflected as Calculated Takeoff Time updates, Slot Compliance State changes, or airport capacity annotations depending on the measure type.
S442: Every operator action, system recommendation, acknowledgement, and rejected alternative is written to the Collaborative Decision Log and the Audit Event Ledger for traceability and post-operation analysis.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
